falcon.addedSync: Connection saved and reading its data now.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.sub: {org} · which severities the system keeps in detail
retention.info: Un-ticking a severity stops collecting it at once. Its stored rows are deleted only after {days} days; ticking it again inside that time cancels the deletion. Falcon totals on the Overview never change: they come from Falcon's own counts.

grace.title: Un-ticking does not delete at once
grace.body: Stored data of an un-ticked severity is deleted after {days} days. Tick it again within {days} days and nothing is lost. After that it has to be read again from Falcon, which can take a while.

confirm.title: Stop keeping detail for {levels}?
confirm.body: Collecting stops now. Stored rows of {levels} are deleted in {days} days ({date}). Falcon totals on the Overview do not change. You can undo this until then.
